## Live census — executed 2026-10-04 (legs: live-executed 15:43Z + 16:01Z)

Command (DSN via `SIG_DISPOSITION_DSN` env only; proxy on
127.0.0.1:5441):

```
uv run python -m ops disposition census \
  --role sig_read_public \
  --spine "sig-pg (read-only sig_read_public)" \
  --out-dir docs/build/reports/p34.26-flagged-org-census \
  --out docs/build/reports/p34.26-flagged-org-census/census-record.json
```

- Connection `sig` → `SET ROLE sig_read_public` (USAGE confirmed via
  `pg_has_role`; transitive through `sig_materialize`) with
  `default_transaction_read_only=on` + `statement_timeout=60s` pinned
  server-side — zero writes by construction. No dedicated read-only
  LOGIN exists yet (P34.43 owns); the session role + read-only
  transaction is the contract's fallback path.
- Non-concurrency: `pg_stat_activity` at 15:42Z showed only
  `cloudsqladmin` + one idle `sig-api` session — **no materializer
  running**; `date -u` 15:42Z, outside 03:00–06:30Z.
- Hosted head (probe): `sqitch.changes` tip =
  `camera_site_human_decisions` — `publication_disposition` is **not
  deployed on hosted** (`to_regclass` → NULL; lands with P34.46).
  The census records `disposition_registry_present: false` and every
  row's `current_disposition` = `none` — the honest state.
- Re-measured (K2 NEW-1 pinned values never restated): **1,559**
  flagged organisations (K2 said 969), edge denominator **43,662**
  (K2 said 42,488), top-50 degree share **92.6 %** (K2 said 96.5 %),
  person-name screen flags **5**.
- **Zero ADR-159 registry matches.** The only identifier scheme any
  flagged org carries on hosted is `sig.org.name` — the withheld
  label. `allow-list.json` therefore carries **0 entries**; all 1,559
  rows type `not yet reviewed`. Auto-allow by registry construction
  is P37.46a/b's intake work; P34.46's apply leg has an empty list
  from this census.
- Defect found + fixed in-run: the first artifact draft (15:43Z)
  listed `sig.org.name` values in the `identifiers` column — a label
  leak into a committed file (the flag withholds exactly that label).
  Label-bearing schemes are now counted
  (`label_identifier_count`), never listed; a DB test asserts the
  name never reaches any artifact. The leg re-ran 16:01:18Z over
  `sig-pg` (same posture) — the committed artifacts carry zero label
  strings (grep-verified).
- Artifacts committed: `CENSUS.md`, `CENSUS.csv` (1,560 lines =
  header + 1,559 rows), `census.json`, `allow-list.json`,
  `census-record.json` under
  `docs/build/reports/p34.26-flagged-org-census/`.
